title: Night Crying
paragraphs: Either way, we had to wait for the cooldown on Portal. I had forgotten that the previous time, Father warned me about the timing of infiltration and retreat. Since I was planning to destroy everything anyway, this was actually too mild. Anyway, it seems I succeeded in rescuing big Sister. This should provide some relief… hopefully. That night, the queen conducted a surprise inspection of the noble’s mansion, and upon discovering the truth, punished the noble who had abused big Sister and his blood relatives under the pretense of “resisting the queen.” It was a good justification. Of course, I made sure to add that they were accompanying one of the Four Cardinal Heroes. Upon arriving in Melromarc, big Sister and her friend were taken to the treatment center. Thanks to the queen’s authority, the healers were diligent in their work, and big Sister and her friend were saved. Father was holding the hand of big Sister’s friend as she lay in bed. No, rather than just holding her hand, she was gripping his hand back.
“Raphtalia-chan, right? Are you okay?”
“Y-Yeah! I’m fine.”
However, big Sister seems to be forcing an awkward smile.
Is this a side effect of the torture? Father seems to have noticed as well but isn’t saying anything.
“I feel out of place. I mean, Naofumi has been acting so decisively that I’ve just ended up watching.”
“Yeah. Without hesitation, he chose to administer the medicine and then carried her on his back… What should we do now?”
“It seems dangerous to move carelessly and stray too far from Motoyasu.”
“It’s the fear of not knowing where the next assassin might come from.”
The sun was starting to set after big Sister was rescued and treated. Considering everything that’s happened today, Father and the others must be exhausted.
“We’ll start moving tomorrow. Ren and Itsuki should be able to fight at least somewhat by the day after tomorrow.”
By the way, the queen was busy giving various instructions at the castle. Before leaving, she entrusted Fiancée to us.
“Melty, Mar… You will support the heroes in place of that crimson swine.”
“Yes, Mother. I dislike standing in for my sister… but I will fulfill my duties properly.”
Fiancée seems to be gathering information from big Sister and her friend.
“Um… you’re Raphtalia-san, and you’re Rifana-san, right? Could you tell me where you used to live? I will do my best to help.”
She seems a little too formal.
Is it because she was ordered by the queen?
“Um… my name is Raphtalia. And this is Rifana-chan.”
“You endured a lot of hardship… On behalf of Melromarc, I apologize.”
Fiancée bowed her head to big Sister and her friend.
“The rampage of our nation’s nobles is ultimately the responsibility of the royal family. I deeply apologize.”
Being bowed to, big Sister looked troubled and shook her head.
“W-We were rescued, so it’s okay! Umm… as long as we can return to our village! Right, Rifana-chan?”
“Yeah… I want to go back to the village, Raphtalia-chan. And also…”
Big Sister’s friend turned to look at Father.
“My name is Iwatani Naofumi. I’m still not used to it, but… I guess I’m the Shield Hero. I’ll help you return to your village.”
“Naofumi-sama… please take care of us.”
“Yeah. Nice to meet you.”
The queen plans to compile and publicly announce the results of the noble inspection. Apparently, Éclair has already been rescued and has provided information.
Things are steadily moving in a positive direction! I can feel it. While I was savoring that sense of accomplishment, Ren and Itsuki were restlessly scanning the surroundings.
“What should we do about tonight…”
“Yes, I’m really anxious.”
“Do you think it’s dangerous to sleep in Melromarc?”
“Well, considering the threat of the Three Heroes Church.”
“After everything they’ve done, we can’t let our guard down.”
“It can’t be helped. We’ll sleep somewhere tonight where even the Three Heroes Church won’t be able to reach us.”
This time, staying at an inn in Zeltoble should be fine.
However, what should we do about big Sister’s weakened friend?
Hmm… On second thought, an inn in Zeltoble seems like the better option. That place is a melting pot of different races. We should be able to manage somehow.
“Cough…”
She’s still coughing. I suppose it’s not something that will heal right away. Since she’s severely weakened, she’s been resting in bed.
“Father, I think we should move for safety.”
“I know, but I’d rather let Rifana-chan rest a little longer… And I don’t want to leave a demi-human child in a country where nobles are capable of doing such things…”
As Father was speaking in a troubled tone, big Sister’s friend desperately tried to get up.
“I-I’m fine. If I’m going with Naofumi-sama and the others, I’ll go. Right, Raphtalia-chan?”
“Y-Yeah!”
She seems to have plenty of determination.
“Then, shall we move?”
“Shouldn’t we leave a message for the queen?”
At that moment, Fiancée stepped forward.
“It’s fine. Mother has the shadows protecting her. And I have been entrusted with assisting the heroes, so I will accompany you as a hostage, in a sense.”
“Melty-chan, right? Are you sure?”
“This is, after all, the mess caused by my country, by Father and Sister. I can’t back down, especially with Mother’s wishes.”
There’s a sense of dignity in Fiancée’s polite response. As expected of my rival. The one who was approved to be betrothed to Filo-tan.
“Alright, let’s quickly move to a country that Motoyasu-kun thinks is safe. We can talk after that.”
“Understood! Portal Spear!”

And so, we moved to Zeltoble, where the Three Heroes Church definitely couldn’t follow us. We secured lodging without any trouble. After all that happened that day, Father and the others went to sleep immediately. Of course, I took advantage of the free time to give a lecture on strengthening methods. Once that’s done, I’ll reveal information about the future.
No, since we’re in Zeltoble, perhaps reuniting with big Sister’s sister should come first? …Come to think of it, I never asked where big Sister’s sister is. That night…
“NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!”
A sudden scream!
“W-What was that!?”
“What happened!?”
Ren and Itsuki woke up at the sound of the scream. Of course, I was also pulled out of a wonderful dream where I was playing tag with Filo-tan on the beach.
“W-What happened!? Raphtalia-chan!?”
“Raphtalia-chan screams when she sleeps deeply… *cough*…”
Big Sister’s friend said, looking confused.
“Father… Mother… No… Noooooooo…”
Father pulled the sleeping big sis into his arms.
“It’s okay… It’s okay now…”
“U… ugh…”

Big Sister, held close by Father, gradually calmed down, and her screams grew quieter. Soon after, there was a loud knock at the door, and the neighboring guests and the innkeeper showed up, looking rather annoyed.
“I’m sorry. It seems this child had a nightmare.”
Father apologized repeatedly, holding big Sister in his arms. Fiancée was about to step forward to apologize, but Father took the lead and did so himself.
“Hey, you know there are people trying to sleep here, right?”
“I’m sorry. I sincerely apologize. I’m very sorry for disturbing your rest.”

As Father bowed his head repeatedly, for some reason, I couldn’t help but see the same expression he wore when he was doing business. Eventually, after saying their piece, the guests and the innkeeper left reluctantly. Well, Zeltoble does have a side that never sleeps, after all.
“The scream was definitely loud, but it’s pretty noisy outside too.”
“Wouldn’t it be better to ask for shelter in a castle in Siltvelt using the Shield Hero’s authority?”
“I wouldn’t recommend that.”
I shared stories about the previous loops when we stayed at the castle in Siltvelt. There were people who subtly tried to assassinate me and Sakura-chan.
“Enemies everywhere… If we don’t get stronger, we can’t even move freely.”
“That’s why Zeltoble is still relatively safer.”
“It’s a mercenary nation, right? In games, it’s known for gambling. It reminds me of making money in the coliseum.”
“Are we setting up base here?”
“For now, there are still things that need to be done in Melromarc.”
“Phew… Finally, we were forgiven.”
“Naofumi-san, you took the lead and apologized so readily. I can’t imagine doing that, but it’s impressive.”
“If bowing my head is enough to get them to forgive us, that’s an easy price to pay. When you’ve done part-time jobs, dealing with complaints becomes second nature.”
As he spoke, Father was gently putting big Sister back to bed.
“I’ve never done that.”
“Me neither.”
“Both of you are the type to play games instead of working part-time?”
“Isn’t that fine?”
“What about you, Motoyasu-kun?”
“I worked part-time at a clothing store to earn money for dates!”
Thanks to my impeccable fashion sense, even pigs flocked to buy my recommendations. Well, thanks to those wealthy pigs, I was able to get whatever I wanted. Big Sister’s breathing had quieted down.
“That’s… typical of Motoyasu, I guess?”
Then, as Father tried to lay her down on the bed—
“Eek—”
Hearing that, Father quickly held her again.
“Hmm… I guess it can’t be helped.”
“It’s impressive how easily Naofumi-san compromises in situations like this. A potential ‘sleeping with a little girl’ incident in the making.”
“Hey, don’t joke about that. After everything she’s been through, of course she’d have trauma. Rifana-chan, are you okay?”
“I’m fine. *Cough*…”
“Really? That’s good, then.”
At that point, big Sister’s friend tugged on the hem of Father’s clothes.
“Can I… sleep with you too?”
Father, looking slightly troubled, nodded after a brief moment.
“There aren’t enough beds, and we’re all sleeping on the floor anyway. Sure.”
“Thank you, Shield… Hero-sama.”
“I’d prefer if you just called me by my name.”
“Yes.”
Saying that, Father laid down with big Sister still in his arms and big Sister’s friend beside him.
“Ah… I see now what he meant when Motoyasu said Naofumi was good with kids.”
“Indeed. Seeing this, it’s hard to believe that this is the same man who cursed the world over a false accusation just this morning.”
“Ren, Itsuki. Let’s keep it down.”
After that, Father began to fall asleep. Well, I suppose we should all go to sleep too. And so, that’s how we all ended up going to sleep that night.
